sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect two main categories of information: (a) Tenant metadata: corporate name, factory slug, employee rosters, and office admin emails. (b) Production telemetry: Purchase Order details, item progress increments, and operator trouble logs.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Data
sections.content: All collected data is used strictly to power your active tracking dashboard, compute weighted stage completions, trigger risk/delay alerts, and generate performance metrics. We do not sell or monetize your operational logs or client list data.

sections.title: 3. Multi-Tenant Data Protection
sections.content: We deploy strict row-level security (Tenant Scope) inside our databases. Each tenant's data is isolated programmatically. Floor operator updates via PIN can only retrieve or mutate items explicitly belonging to their designated Tenant scope.

sections.title: 4. Worker PIN & Authenticator Security
sections.content: Operator login PIN codes are encrypted and stored securely. Office passwords are hashed using bcrypt. Our support team cannot read your worker PIN codes; they can only trigger a reset request upon administrative approval.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention & Backups
sections.content: Your operational logs, KPI stats, and order records are retained as long as your tenant subscription is active. Daily database backups are encrypted and stored in secure cloud nodes with 14-day rotation periods.

sections.title: 6. Changes to this Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When changes are made, we will update the 'Last updated' date at the top of this page. Continued use of POgrid.id constitutes acceptance of updated terms.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By registering for and using the POgrid.id application, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, you must not access or use our services.

sections.title: 2. Account Registration & Tenant Security
sections.content: Tenants (factory owners or managers) are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their office accounts, employee rosters, and floor operator PIN codes. Any production updates logged via worker PINs are deemed authorized by the Tenant. POgrid.id is not liable for unauthorized logins or PIN breaches caused by internal sharing.

sections.title: 3. Service Scope & Real-Time Tracking
sections.content: POgrid.id provides real-time progress tracking, bottleneck analysis, and automated alerts for Purchase Orders (PO) and manufacturing projects. The services are provided 'as is' and 'as available.' We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operations under unstable cellular network conditions on factory floors.

sections.title: 4. Liquidated Damages & Delay Penalties Disclaimer
sections.content: POgrid.id acts strictly as a visibility and tracking helper. Under no circumstances shall POgrid.id, its developers, or parent company be held liable for actual delay penalties (pinalti denda), project liquidated damages (denda keterlambatan), or cancelled Purchase Orders resulting from delays on your production floor. The final delivery and quality compliance remain the sole responsibility of the Tenant.

sections.title: 5. Data Ownership & Intellectual Property
sections.content: You retain all intellectual property rights and ownership over your uploaded POs, client databases, and item lists. POgrid.id retains all rights, titles, and interests in the software, algorithms, themes, and codebase of the application.

sections.title: 6. Service Termination & Data Deletion
sections.content: You may terminate your account at any time via Profile Settings. Upon termination, we will delete or anonymize all production data, operator logs, and client archives associated with your tenant within 30 business days, subject to regulatory storage compliance.

sections.title: 7. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
sections.content: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any disputes arising out of the use of this service shall be referred to the exclusive jurisdiction of the District Court of Jakarta.

Landing_Landing.pain_title: The daily reality on the shop floor that keeps owners guessing
Landing_Landing.pain_sub: Every factory owner and purchasing team recognizes these situations:

pain_items.q: "Where is my order in the queue? Why hasn\'t it shipped?"
pain_items.a: Your phone rings every afternoon with customer complaints — and you cannot answer confidently because floor data is still guesswork.

pain_items.q: Discovering delays on shipping day — when the client penalty is due
pain_items.a: No early warning. Delays surface only when the truck is ready to load, ending in delivery penalties, invoice deductions, purchasing complaints, or risk of losing the next order.

pain_items.q: Progress tracked on crumpled paper and whiteboards
pain_items.a: Work orders get lost, damaged, or forgotten. Owners have no reliable view of actual progress on the floor.

pain_items.q: Promising delivery dates based on gut feeling
pain_items.a: Without per-stage data (cutting, turning, CNC, welding, QC), every delivery promise carries the cost of being late.

Landing_Landing.pain_solution: POgrid.id exists for one purpose: warn you early before a PO slips, so your team can clear the bottleneck and reduce exposure to client delivery penalties.
Landing_Landing.how_title: Three simple steps: operators update from the floor, owners stay informed
Landing_Landing.how_sub: No complicated computer training. A few steps from a phone at the workbench.

steps.title: Operators log progress with a short PIN
steps.desc: No email or password. Operators at CNC, lathe, welding, or QC stations select their name, enter a 4–6 digit PIN, and key in completed units.

steps.title: Progress is calculated automatically around your workflow
steps.desc: POgrid computes completion percentage across your production stages — for example Drafter → Machining → Assembly → QC → Delivery.

steps.title: Owners monitor status before orders become late
steps.desc: Open the dashboard from any laptop or phone. Get warned when a stage starts slipping, before the PO crosses its delivery deadline and creates penalty risk.

Landing_Landing.how_outcome: The result: you know which orders are safe, at risk, or delayed — and which production stage is causing the risk — before a client escalates penalties.
Landing_Landing.feat_sub: Accurate PO status at a glance — without the complexity of an ERP.

faqs.q: Is this a factory ERP or accounting system?
faqs.a: No. POgrid.id focuses on purchase order progress tracking and on-time delivery. We deliberately leave out accounting and raw-material inventory modules so the system can be adopted faster.

faqs.q: What if my operators are not tech-savvy?
faqs.a: That is exactly who it is designed for. Operators barely type any letters — they select their name, enter a 4–6 digit PIN, and key in completed units. Training is short.

faqs.q: Do we need to install an app on phones?
faqs.a: No installation. Open a link in any browser (Chrome/Safari) on any phone or laptop. Data is stored in the production cloud and the dashboard updates as soon as operators submit.

faqs.q: How long does setup take before the first PO?
faqs.a: Usually just a few minutes. Right after registration you can configure your production stages and create your first PO.

faqs.q: What does it cost after the 30-day free trial?
faqs.a: Rp250,000 per month billed annually (Rp3,000,000 per year) for one plant, including every feature. No setup fee, and no credit card is required during the trial.

faqs.q: Is it available in English and Indonesian?
faqs.a: Yes. The product interface supports both English and Bahasa Indonesia, using terminology familiar to local production floors (PO, Rework, Milling, CNC, Progress, Delayed).

POgrid stores the operational data needed for tracking: PO numbers, client names, project items, stages, progress, users, and delivery/finance status. POgrid does not ask for national ID numbers, credit card data, payroll data, or engineering drawing files. Each company’s data is separated per tenant, with access controlled by account and user role.
